A systematic meta-analysis of genetic, regional, and production determinants of global pork quality

Code and model outputs - Color Score

1 Loading packages and data

## load the packages
library(metafor)
library(orchaRd)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(openxlsx)
library(MuMIn)
library(glue)
library(rlang)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
## Load the functions from the script file
source("functions.R")
## Load the data for Color Score
data_CS <- read.csv("CS.csv")

## Convert columns to appropriate numeric types
data_CS$Mean <- as.numeric(data_CS$Mean)
data_CS$SD <- as.numeric(data_CS$SD)
data_CS$Sample <- as.numeric(data_CS$Sample)
data_CS$Age <- as.numeric(data_CS$Age)
data_CS$Weight <- as.numeric(data_CS$Weight)
data_CS$Digestible_energy <- as.numeric(data_CS$Digestible_energy)
data_CS$Crude_protein <- as.numeric(data_CS$Crude_protein)
data_CS$Crude_fat <- as.numeric(data_CS$Crude_fat)
data_CS$Crude_fiber <- as.numeric(data_CS$Crude_fiber)
data_CS$Ash <- as.numeric(data_CS$Ash)
data_CS$Lys <- as.numeric(data_CS$Lys)
data_CS$Met_and_Cys <- as.numeric(data_CS$Met_and_Cys)
data_CS$Thr <- as.numeric(data_CS$Thr)
data_CS$Try <- as.numeric(data_CS$Try)
data_CS$Val <- as.numeric(data_CS$Val)
data_CS$Dry_matter <- as.numeric(data_CS$Dry_matter)
data_CS$Ca <- as.numeric(data_CS$Ca)
data_CS$P <- as.numeric(data_CS$P)
data_CS$Na <- as.numeric(data_CS$Na)

## Convert columns to factor types
data_CS$Position <- factor(data_CS$Position)
data_CS$Breed <- factor(data_CS$Breed)
data_CS$Class <- factor(data_CS$Class)
data_CS$Sex <- factor(data_CS$Sex)
data_CS$Region <- factor(data_CS$Region)
data_CS$Aim <- factor(data_CS$Aim)
data_CS$Multiple_breeds <- factor(data_CS$Multiple_breeds)

## Calculate variance (rVar)
# rVar is the square of the standard error (SD/sqrt(Sample))
data_CS$rVar <- (data_CS$SD/sqrt(data_CS$Sample))^2

2 Testing random effects

## Run VCV matrix for all data
VCV_CS_AllData <- make_VCV_matrix(data_CS, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")

## Null model with VCV matrix:
# This model includes random effects for RowID (observation-level) and StudyID.
null_CS_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_CS_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_CS, method = "ML")
summary(null_CS_mod) #-962.9919         
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 478; method: ML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
##  484.4959  2107.7319  -962.9919  -950.4831  -962.9413   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0035  0.0588    478     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  0.0060  0.0776    231     no  StudyID 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 477) = 331800.0264, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval   ci.lb   ci.ub      
##   0.5613  0.0062  90.4007  <.0001  0.5491  0.5734  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## Test whether Region should be a random effect:
# Adds Region as a random effect to the null model structure.
Re_CS_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_CS_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID,
                                     ~1 |Region),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_CS, method = "ML")
summary(Re_CS_mod) #-965.8801            
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 478; method: ML)

##

## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0035  0.0589    478     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  0.0054  0.0738    231     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  0.0005  0.0225     32     no   Region 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:

## Full model with fixed effects for Position, Breed, Region, and Class
CS_full_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_CS_AllData, 
                      mods = ~Position + Breed + Region + Class,
                      random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID),
                      sparse = TRUE,
                      data = data_CS, method = "ML")
R2_Full <- round(r2_ml(CS_full_mod)*100, 2)
anova(CS_full_mod,null_CS_mod)
## 
##          df       AIC       BIC      AICc   logLik      LRT   pval          QE 
## Full    195 -883.2735  -70.1994 -612.2096 636.6367                  13319.2643 
## Reduced   3 -962.9919 -950.4831 -962.9413 484.4959 304.2816 <.0001 331800.0264
## Model with Position as a fixed effect
CS_Position_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_CS_AllData, 
                           mods = ~Position,
                           random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                         ~1 |StudyID),
                           sparse = TRUE,
                           data = data_CS, method = "ML")
R2_Position <-round(r2_ml(CS_Position_mod)*100, 2)
anova(CS_Position_mod,null_CS_mod)
## 
##         df       AIC       BIC      AICc   logLik     LRT   pval          QE 
## Full    13 -969.3310 -915.1261 -968.5466 497.6655                330670.7197 
## Reduced  3 -962.9919 -950.4831 -962.9413 484.4959 26.3391 0.0033 331800.0264
## Model with Breed as a fixed effect
CS_Breed_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_CS_AllData,

R2_Breed <- round(r2_ml(CS_Breed_mod)*100, 2)
anova(CS_Breed_mod,null_CS_mod)

R2_Region <- round(r2_ml(CS_Region_mod)*100, 2)

## Model with Class as a fixed effect
CS_Class_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_CS_AllData, 
                           mods = ~Class,
                           random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                         ~1 |StudyID),
                           sparse = TRUE,

R2_Class <- round(r2_ml(CS_Class_mod)*100, 2)
anova(CS_Class_mod,null_CS_mod)
## 
##         df       AIC       BIC      AICc   logLik     LRT   pval          QE 
## Full    10 -976.1312 -934.4351 -975.6601 498.0656                222520.9295 
## Reduced  3 -962.9919 -950.4831 -962.9413 484.4959 27.1393 0.0003 331800.0264
## Create a table of R-squared values for models with moderators
R2_models_summary <- data.frame("Model" = c("Full",
                                    "Position",
                                    "Breed",
                                    "Region",
                                    "Class"),
                        "R2" = c(R2_Full[1],
                                 R2_Position[1],
                                 R2_Breed[1],
                                 R2_Region[1],
                                 R2_Class[1]))
R2_models_summary <- R2_models_summary %>% 
  transmute(Model = Model
            ,R2= round(R2,2))

colnames(R2_models_summary)[2] <- "$R^2(\\%)$"

R2_models_summary %>% 
  kable(format="html", escape=F, caption="Heterogeneity explained in the models with moderators") %>% 
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>% 
  kable_styling(c("hover", "condensed"), full_width = F)

## Refit with REML for reporting in Manuscript
REML_CS_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_CS_AllData, 
                        random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                      ~1 |StudyID,
                                      ~1 |Region,
                                      # ~1 | Position, # Position was not better than null in initial test
                                      ~1 |Breed), 
                        sparse = TRUE,
                        data = data_CS, method = "REML")
summary(REML_CS_mod)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 478; method: REML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
##  489.1909  -978.3817  -968.3817  -947.5441  -968.2543   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0034  0.0579    478     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  0.0051  0.0715    231     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  0.0002  0.0157     32     no   Region 
## sigma^2.4  0.0004  0.0194    154     no    Breed 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 477) = 331800.0264, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval   ci.lb   ci.ub      
##   0.5683  0.0077  73.3376  <.0001  0.5531  0.5835  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
# Calculate I-squared values
round(i2_ml(REML_CS_mod), 2)
##   I2_Total   I2_RowID I2_StudyID  I2_Region   I2_Breed 
##      99.92      36.87      56.20       2.72       4.14
# Calculate R-squared
round(r2_ml(REML_CS_mod)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##            0.0           63.1
## Generate orchard plot for the REML model
p_REML_CS <- orchard_plot(REML_CS_mod,
                               group = "StudyID",  
                               xlab = "Mean Color Score", 
                               cb = FALSE,
                               angle = 0,
                               legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                               branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_REML_CS)

3 Meta-regression

3.1 Breed

## Filter data for breeds with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_CS_B3 <- data_CS %>%
  group_by(Breed) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(StudyID) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

## Create VCV matrix for the filtered breed data
VCV_CS_B3_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_CS_B3, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")
## Define random structure
random_structure_breed <- list(~1 |RowID,
                               ~1 |StudyID,
                               ~1 |Region)

# Model with intercept
Br_VCV_REML_CS_mod_int <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_CS_B3_Data,
  mods = ~ Breed,
  random = random_structure_breed,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_CS_B3)
summary(Br_VCV_REML_CS_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 263; method: REML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc

# Model without intercept for plotting
Br_VCV_REML_CS_mod <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_CS_B3_Data,
  mods = ~ Breed -1,
  random = random_structure_breed,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_CS_B3)
## Orchard plot for Breed moderator
p_Br_VCV_REML_CS <- orchard_plot(Br_VCV_REML_CS_mod, 
                                  mod = "Breed",  
                                  group = "StudyID",  
                                  xlab = "Mean Color Score", 
                                  cb = FALSE,
                                  angle = 0,
                                  legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                                  branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_Br_VCV_REML_CS)

## Generate table of pairwise comparisons for Breed using all_models function
res_CS_Br <- all_models(
  data        = data_CS_B3,
  vcv         = VCV_CS_B3_Data,
  yi_col      = "Mean",
  mod_name    = "Breed",
  random_list = random_structure_breed 
)

3.2 Class

## Filter data for Class with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_CS_Cl <- data_CS %>%
  group_by(Class) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(StudyID) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

## Create VCV matrix for the filtered Class data

                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")
## Define random structure
random_structure_class <- list(~1 |RowID,
                               ~1 |StudyID,
                               ~1 |Region,
                               ~1 |Breed)
  
# Model with intercept
Cl_VCV_REML_CS_mod_int <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_CS_Cl_Data,
  mods = ~ Class,
  random = random_structure_class,
  test = "t",

random_structure_continuous <- list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID,
                                    ~1 |Region,
                                    ~1 |Breed)

## Run meta-regression for Age
res_CS_Age <- run_meta_ct(
  dat         = data_CS_Age,          
  mod_var     = "Age",

)

## Generate summary table for Age models
mods_list_age <- attr(res_CS_Age$best_model, "mods_list") 
aic_tab_age   <- res_CS_Age$aic_table                   

tbl_CS_Age <- model_summary_tbl(
  mods_list_age, aic_tab_age, 
  lin_coef  = "mod_c",              
  quad_coef = "mod_c2"
)
## Display summary table for Age models
html_table_age <- tbl_CS_Age %>% 
  kable(format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")

3.12 Ash

## Filter data for complete cases of Ash
data_CS_As <- data_CS[complete.cases(data_CS$Ash), ]

## Create VCV matrix for Ash data
VCV_CS_As_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_CS_As, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")
# 1. Data Preparation
data_CS_As <- data_CS_As %>%
  filter(!is.na(Ash), !is.na(Mean), !is.na(rVar)) %>%
  mutate(
    mu     = mean(Ash, na.rm = TRUE),
    As_c   = Ash - mu,
    As_c2  = As_c^2,
    Prec   = 1 / sqrt(rVar)
  )

VCV_CS_As_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(
  data_CS_As,
  V       = "rVar",
  cluster = "StudyID",
  obs     = "RowID"
)

# 2. Model Fitting & Selection
rand_layers <- list(~1|RowID, ~1|StudyID, ~1|Region)
ctrl <- list(optimizer="optim", optmethod="BFGS", maxiter=2000, reltol=1e-8)

fit0 <- rma.mv(Mean, VCV_CS_As_Data, mods = ~1,
               random = rand_layers, data = data_CS_As,
               method="ML", test="t", control=ctrl)
fit1 <- rma.mv(Mean, VCV_CS_As_Data, mods = ~As_c,
               random = rand_layers, data = data_CS_As,
               method="ML", test="t", control=ctrl)
fit2 <- rma.mv(Mean, VCV_CS_As_Data, mods = ~As_c + As_c2,
               random = rand_layers, data = data_CS_As,
               method="ML", test="t", control=ctrl)

ms_tab <- model.sel(list(fit0=fit0, fit1=fit1, fit2=fit2), rank="AICc")
print(ms_tab, digits=3)
## Model selection table 
##      (Int)     mods df logLik  AICc delta weight
## fit0     +           4 16.860 -23.5  0.00  0.805
## fit1     +      A_c  5 16.860 -20.2  3.31  0.154
## fit2     + A_c+A_c2  6 17.409 -17.6  5.93  0.042
## Abbreviations:
##  mods:  = '~1', A_c = '~As_c', A_c+A_c2 = '~As_c+As_c2'
## Models ranked by AICc(x)
anova(fit0, fit1)
## 
##         df      AIC      BIC     AICc  logLik    LRT   pval        QE 
## Full     5 -23.7197 -18.0422 -20.1903 16.8598               1115.0791 
## Reduced  4 -25.7194 -21.1775 -23.4972 16.8597 0.0002 0.9874 1116.2828
anova(fit1, fit2)
## 
##         df      AIC      BIC     AICc  logLik    LRT   pval        QE 
## Full     6 -22.8184 -16.0055 -17.5684 17.4092               1099.6632 
## Reduced  5 -23.7197 -18.0422 -20.1903 16.8598 1.0988 0.2945 1115.0791
best_key <- rownames(ms_tab)[1]
best_mod <- switch(best_key,
                   fit0 = update(fit0, method="REML"),
                   fit1 = update(fit1, method="REML"),
                   fit2 = update(fit2, method="REML"))

# 3. Plotting Functions
plot_linear <- function(model, df) {
  mu   <- mean(df$Ash, na.rm=TRUE)
  newdat <- data.frame(
    Ash = seq(min(df$Ash), max(df$Ash), length.out=200)
  ) %>% mutate(
    As_c = Ash - mu
  )
  ci   <- predict(model, newmods=newdat$As_c)
  newdat <- newdat %>% mutate(
    fit    = ci$pred,
    ci_lwr = ci$ci.lb,
    ci_upr = ci$ci.ub
  )
  beta1 <- coef(model)["As_c"]
  p_val <- summary(model)$pval["As_c"]
  R2m   <- r2_ml(model)["R2_marginal"]*100

  ggplot(df, aes(Ash, Mean)) +
    geom_point(aes(size=Prec), shape=21, fill="grey65",
               colour="black", stroke=.25, alpha=.6) +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(.5,4), name="Precision\n(1/SE)") +
    geom_ribbon(data=newdat,
                aes(x=Ash, ymin=ci_lwr, ymax=ci_upr),
                fill="grey85", alpha=.5, inherit.aes=FALSE) +
    geom_line(data=newdat,
              aes(x=Ash, y=fit),
              colour="firebrick", linewidth=.9) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Ash)+.03*diff(range(df$Ash)),
             y=min(df$Mean)+.07*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("β = %.3f\nR² = %.2f%%\nP = %.3g",
                           beta1, R2m, p_val),
             colour="blue4", hjust=0, size=3.2) +
    labs(x="Ash (% DM)", y="Aspartic acid (%)") +
    theme_classic(base_size=11) +
    theme(panel.border=element_rect(colour="black", fill=NA),
          legend.position=c(.98,.99),
          legend.justification=c(1,1))
}

plot_quadratic <- function(model, df) {
  mu   <- mean(df$Ash, na.rm=TRUE)
  newdat <- data.frame(
    Ash = seq(min(df$Ash), max(df$Ash), length.out=200)
  ) %>% mutate(
    As_c  = Ash - mu,
    As_c2 = As_c^2
  )
  ci   <- predict(model, newmods=as.matrix(newdat[,c("As_c","As_c2")]))
  newdat <- newdat %>% mutate(
    fit    = ci$pred,
    ci_lwr = ci$ci.lb,
    ci_upr = ci$ci.ub
  )
  b1    <- coef(model)["As_c"]
  b2    <- coef(model)["As_c2"]
  x_opt <- -b1/(2*b2) + mu
  p_val <- summary(model)$pval["As_c2"]
  R2m   <- r2_ml(model)["R2_marginal"]*100

  ggplot(df, aes(Ash, Mean)) +
    geom_point(aes(size=Prec), shape=21, fill="grey65",
               colour="black", stroke=.25, alpha=.6) +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(.5,4), name="Precision\n(1/SE)") +
    geom_ribbon(data=newdat,
                aes(x=Ash, ymin=ci_lwr, ymax=ci_upr),
                fill="grey85", alpha=.5) +
    geom_line(data=newdat,
              aes(x=Ash, y=fit),
              colour="firebrick", linewidth=.9) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=x_opt,
               linetype="dashed", colour="red3",
               linewidth=.8) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Ash)+.02*diff(range(df$Ash)),
             y=max(df$Mean)-.03*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("Ash = %.1f%%", x_opt),
             hjust=0, vjust=1, size=3.2) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Ash)+.03*diff(range(df$Ash)),
             y=min(df$Mean)+.07*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("R² = %.2f%%\nP = %.3g", R2m, p_val),
             colour="blue4", hjust=0, size=3.2) +
    labs(x="Ash (% DM)", y="Aspartic acid (%)") +
    theme_classic(base_size=11) +
    theme(panel.border=element_rect(colour="black", fill=NA),
          axis.ticks.length=unit(0.15,"cm"),
          legend.position=c(.98,.99),
          legend.justification=c(1,1)) +
    coord_cartesian(expand=FALSE)
}

# 4. Plotting based on best model
if (best_key == "fit1") {
  print(plot_linear(best_mod, data_CS_As))
} else if (best_key == "fit2") {
  print(plot_quadratic(best_mod, data_CS_As))
} else {
  message("No significant effect of Ash")
}

mods <- list(
  Linear    = fit1,
  Quadratic = fit2,
  Null      = fit0
)

aic_tab <- ms_tab                          

map_names <- c(fit0 = "Null", fit1 = "Linear", fit2 = "Quadratic")
rownames(aic_tab) <- map_names[rownames(aic_tab)]

best_row   <- rownames(aic_tab)[1]
best_label <- c(Null="Null", Linear="Linear", Quadratic="Quadratic")[best_row]


tbl_CS_As <- bind_rows(lapply(names(mods), function(label){
  m <- mods[[label]]
  R2m <- r2_ml(m)["R2_marginal"] * 100
  
  if (label == "Linear") {               
    p_val <- summary(m)$pval[2]              
  } else if (label == "Quadratic") {      
    p_val <- summary(m)$pval[3]             
  } else {                                
    p_val <- NA
  }
  
  AICc  <- aic_tab[label, "AICc"]
  delta <- aic_tab[label, "delta"]
  
  data.frame(
    Model         = label,
    Adjusted_R2   = round(R2m, 2),
    P_value       = signif(p_val, 3),
    AICc          = round(AICc, 2),
    Delta_AICc    = round(delta, 2),
    Selected_Model= ifelse(label == best_label, "✔", "")
  )
}))


print(tbl_CS_As)
##                     Model Adjusted_R2 P_value   AICc Delta_AICc Selected_Model
## R2_marginal...1    Linear        0.00   0.993 -20.19       3.31               
## R2_marginal...2 Quadratic        6.21   0.295 -17.57       5.93               
## R2_marginal...3      Null        0.00      NA -23.50       0.00              ✔

3.21 Na (Sodium)

## Filter data for complete cases of Sodium (Na)
data_CS_Na <- data_CS[complete.cases(data_CS$Na), ]
 
## Create VCV matrix for Sodium data
VCV_CS_Na_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_CS_Na, 
                                    V = "rVar", 
                                    cluster = "StudyID", 
                                    obs = "RowID")
# 1. Data Preparation
data_CS_Na <- data_CS_Na %>%
  filter(!is.na(Na), !is.na(Mean), !is.na(rVar)) %>%
  mutate(
    mu     = mean(Na, na.rm = TRUE),
    Na_c   = Na - mu,
    Na_c2  = Na_c^2,
    Prec   = 1 / sqrt(rVar)
  )

VCV_CS_Na_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(
  data_CS_Na,
  V       = "rVar",
  cluster = "StudyID",
  obs     = "RowID"
)

# 2. Model Fitting & Selection
rand_layers <- list(~1|RowID, ~1|StudyID, ~1|Region, ~1|Breed)
ctrl <- list(optimizer="optim", optmethod="BFGS", maxiter=2000, reltol=1e-8)

fit0 <- rma.mv(Mean, VCV_CS_Na_Data, mods = ~1,
               random = rand_layers, data = data_CS_Na,
               method="ML", test="t", control=ctrl)
fit1 <- rma.mv(Mean, VCV_CS_Na_Data, mods = ~Na_c,
               random = rand_layers, data = data_CS_Na,
               method="ML", test="t", control=ctrl)
fit2 <- rma.mv(Mean, VCV_CS_Na_Data, mods = ~Na_c + Na_c2,
               random = rand_layers, data = data_CS_Na,
               method="ML", test="t", control=ctrl)

ms_tab <- model.sel(list(fit0=fit0, fit1=fit1, fit2=fit2), rank="AICc")
print(ms_tab, digits=3)
## Model selection table 
##      (Int)     mods df logLik  AICc delta weight
## fit0     +           5 20.830 -24.2  0.00  0.841
## fit1     +      N_c  6 22.382 -20.8  3.40  0.154
## fit2     + N_c+N_c2  7 23.260 -13.9 10.31  0.005
## Abbreviations:
##  mods:  = '~1', N_c = '~Na_c', N_c+N_c2 = '~Na_c+Na_c2'
## Models ranked by AICc(x)
anova(fit0, fit1)
## 
##         df      AIC      BIC     AICc  logLik    LRT   pval       QE 
## Full     6 -32.7630 -28.9287 -20.7630 22.3815               206.5432 
## Reduced  5 -31.6606 -28.4653 -24.1606 20.8303 3.1024 0.0782 352.2306
anova(fit1, fit2)
## 
##         df      AIC      BIC     AICc  logLik    LRT   pval       QE 
## Full     7 -32.5207 -28.0473 -13.8541 23.2604               132.0015 
## Reduced  6 -32.7630 -28.9287 -20.7630 22.3815 1.7577 0.1849 206.5432
best_key <- rownames(ms_tab)[1]
best_mod <- switch(best_key,
                   fit0 = update(fit0, method="REML"),
                   fit1 = update(fit1, method="REML"),
                   fit2 = update(fit2, method="REML"))

# 3. Plotting Functions
plot_linear <- function(model, df) {
  mu   <- mean(df$Na, na.rm=TRUE)
  newdat <- data.frame(
    Na = seq(min(df$Na), max(df$Na), length.out=200)
  ) %>% mutate(
    Na_c = Na - mu
  )
  ci   <- predict(model, newmods=newdat$Na_c)
  newdat <- newdat %>% mutate(
    fit    = ci$pred,
    ci_lwr = ci$ci.lb,
    ci_upr = ci$ci.ub
  )
  beta1 <- coef(model)["Na_c"]
  p_val <- summary(model)$pval["Na_c"]
  R2m   <- r2_ml(model)["R2_marginal"]*100
  
  ggplot(df, aes(Na, Mean)) +
    geom_point(aes(size=Prec), shape=21, fill="grey65",
               colour="black", stroke=.25, alpha=.6) +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(.5,4), name="Precision\n(1/SE)") +
    geom_ribbon(data=newdat,
                aes(x=Na, ymin=ci_lwr, ymax=ci_upr),
                fill="grey85", alpha=.5, inherit.aes=FALSE) +
    geom_line(data=newdat,
              aes(x=Na, y=fit),
              colour="firebrick", linewidth=.9) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Na)+.03*diff(range(df$Na)),
             y=min(df$Mean)+.07*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("β = %.3f\nR² = %.2f%%\nP = %.3g",
                           beta1, R2m, p_val),
             colour="blue4", hjust=0, size=3.2) +
    labs(x="Na (% DM)", y="Aspartic acid (%)") +
    theme_classic(base_size=11) +
    theme(panel.border=element_rect(colour="black", fill=NA),
          legend.position=c(.98,.99),
          legend.justification=c(1,1))
}

plot_quadratic <- function(model, df) {
  mu   <- mean(df$Na, na.rm=TRUE)
  newdat <- data.frame(
    Na = seq(min(df$Na), max(df$Na), length.out=200)
  ) %>% mutate(
    Na_c  = Na - mu,
    Na_c2 = Na_c^2
  )
  ci   <- predict(model, newmods=as.matrix(newdat[,c("Na_c","Na_c2")]))
  newdat <- newdat %>% mutate(
    fit    = ci$pred,
    ci_lwr = ci$ci.lb,
    ci_upr = ci$ci.ub
  )
  b1    <- coef(model)["Na_c"]
  b2    <- coef(model)["Na_c2"]
  x_opt <- -b1/(2*b2) + mu
  p_val <- summary(model)$pval["Na_c2"]
  R2m   <- r2_ml(model)["R2_marginal"]*100
  
  ggplot(df, aes(Na, Mean)) +
    geom_point(aes(size=Prec), shape=21, fill="grey65",
               colour="black", stroke=.25, alpha=.6) +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(.5,4), name="Precision\n(1/SE)") +
    geom_ribbon(data=newdat,
                aes(x=Na, ymin=ci_lwr, ymax=ci_upr),
                fill="grey85", alpha=.5) +
    geom_line(data=newdat,
              aes(x=Na, y=fit),
              colour="firebrick", linewidth=.9) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=x_opt,
               linetype="dNaed", colour="red3",
               linewidth=.8) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Na)+.02*diff(range(df$Na)),
             y=max(df$Mean)-.03*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("Na = %.1f%%", x_opt),
             hjust=0, vjust=1, size=3.2) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Na)+.03*diff(range(df$Na)),
             y=min(df$Mean)+.07*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("R² = %.2f%%\nP = %.3g", R2m, p_val),
             colour="blue4", hjust=0, size=3.2) +
    labs(x="Na (% DM)", y="Aspartic acid (%)") +
    theme_classic(base_size=11) +
    theme(panel.border=element_rect(colour="black", fill=NA),
          axis.ticks.length=unit(0.15,"cm"),
          legend.position=c(.98,.99),
          legend.justification=c(1,1)) +
    coord_cartesian(expand=FALSE)
}

# 4. Plotting based on best model
if (best_key == "fit1") {
  print(plot_linear(best_mod, data_CS_Na))
} else if (best_key == "fit2") {
  print(plot_quadratic(best_mod, data_CS_Na))
} else {
  message("No significant effect of Na")
}

mods <- list(
  Linear    = fit1,
  Quadratic = fit2,
  Null      = fit0
)

aic_tab <- ms_tab                          

map_names <- c(fit0 = "Null", fit1 = "Linear", fit2 = "Quadratic")
rownames(aic_tab) <- map_names[rownames(aic_tab)]

best_row   <- rownames(aic_tab)[1]
best_label <- c(Null="Null", Linear="Linear", Quadratic="Quadratic")[best_row]


tbl_CS_Na <- bind_rows(lapply(names(mods), function(label){
  m <- mods[[label]]
  R2m <- r2_ml(m)["R2_marginal"] * 100
  
  if (label == "Linear") {               
    p_val <- summary(m)$pval[2]              
  } else if (label == "Quadratic") {      
    p_val <- summary(m)$pval[3]             
  } else {                                
    p_val <- NA
  }
  
  AICc  <- aic_tab[label, "AICc"]
  delta <- aic_tab[label, "delta"]
  
  data.frame(
    Model         = label,
    Adjusted_R2   = round(R2m, 2),
    P_value       = signif(p_val, 3),
    AICc          = round(AICc, 2),
    Delta_AICc    = round(delta, 2),
    Selected_Model= ifelse(label == best_label, "✔", "")
  )
}))


print(tbl_CS_Na)
##                     Model Adjusted_R2 P_value   AICc Delta_AICc Selected_Model
## R2_marginal...1    Linear       40.93  0.0251 -20.76       3.40               
## R2_marginal...2 Quadratic       37.69  0.1770 -13.85      10.31               
## R2_marginal...3      Null        0.00      NA -24.16       0.00              ✔
## Display summary table for Sodium models
html_table_na <- tbl_CS_Na %>% # Changed from html_table
  kable(format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")  
print(html_table_na)

3.22 CP_DE_ratio

## Filter data for non-missing Crude_protein and Digestible_energy, then calculate ratio
data_CS_CP_DE_ratio <- data_CS %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Crude_protein),
    !is.na(Digestible_energy),
    Digestible_energy != 0 
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    CP_DE_Ratio = Crude_protein / Digestible_energy
  )

## Create VCV matrix for CP_DE_Ratio data
VCV_CS_CP_DE_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_CS_CP_DE_ratio, 
                                      V = "rVar", 
                                      cluster = "StudyID", 
                                      obs = "RowID")
## Run meta-regression for CP_DE_Ratio
res_CS_CP_DE_ratio <- run_meta_ct(
  dat         = data_CS_CP_DE_ratio,          
  mod_var     = "CP_DE_Ratio",
  random_list = random_structure_continuous, 
  plot_name   = "p_CS_CP_DE_ratio",              
  x_lab       = "Ratio of crude protein to digestible energy (g/MJ)",
  y_lab       = "Color Score" 
)

## Generate summary table for CP_DE_Ratio models

4 Publication bias and sensitivity analyses

4.1 Decline effect (Publication Year)

## Define random structure
random_structure_Ye <- list(~1 |RowID,
                            ~1 |StudyID,
                            ~1 |Region,
                            ~1 |Breed)

## Model with Publication Year (Years) as moderator
Ye_VCV_REML_CS_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_CS_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Years,
   random = random_structure_Ye, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_CS)
summary(Ye_VCV_REML_CS_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 478; method: REML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
##  488.1326  -976.2653  -964.2653  -939.2728  -964.0862   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0034  0.0579    478     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  0.0051  0.0717    231     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  0.0002  0.0158     32     no   Region 
## sigma^2.4  0.0004  0.0195    154     no    Breed 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 476) = 328743.5479, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 476) = 0.0811, p-val = 0.7759
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##          estimate      se     tval   df    pval    ci.lb   ci.ub    
## intrcpt   -0.6101  4.1374  -0.1475  476  0.8828  -8.7399  7.5197    
## Years      0.0006  0.0020   0.2848  476  0.7759  -0.0034  0.0046    
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Ye_VCV_REML_CS_mod_int)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.03          63.26
## Bubble plot for decline effect
p_Ye_VCV_REML_CS <- bubble_plot(Ye_VCV_REML_CS_mod_int,
                                  mod = "Years",
                                  group = "StudyID",
                                  xlab = "Publication year",
                                  ylab = "Mean Color Score",
                                  g = TRUE)
 
p_Ye_VCV_REML_CS <- p_Ye_VCV_REML_CS + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2014, 2024, by = 2))
 
print(p_Ye_VCV_REML_CS)
